speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you mentioned a significant medical history but didn't provide the details. Can you please describe your past medical conditions and any medications you are currently taking? Additionally, do you have any family history of neurological disorders or genetic conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like acute ataxia; do you have any specific medical conditions like multiple sclerosis, stroke, or autoimmune disorders, and are you taking any new medications? Also, have you experienced any double vision, slurred speech, or recent head trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy in a patient with Crohn's disease.
